name: USDH Stablecoin
oneLiner: USDH is Native Markets' Hyperliquid dollar stablecoin issued by Bridge (Stripe), redeemable 1:1 against cash, U.S. Treasuries, repos, and tokenized treasuries.
collateral: Held reserves per the March 2026 attestation: tokenized asset-backed tokens (Superstate USTB ~65%, USDC ~13%), US government money market funds (~22%), and cash and cash equivalents at US-regulated banks (~1%). Eligible reserves per the stablecoin terms also include short-term US Treasury bills (<=3 months), overnight reverse repurchase agreements collateralized by US Treasuries, deposit accounts, and tokenized versions of these assets. Offchain reserves managed by BlackRock and custodied with JPMorgan Chase; onchain reserves managed by Superstate and custodied via Fireblocks MPC infrastructure. Designed by Native Markets, issued by Bridge Building Inc. (a subsidiary of Stripe, Inc., incorporated in Delaware).
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 mint/redemption through Bridge Building Inc. (a Stripe subsidiary, FinCEN MSB); fully reserved by cash and cash equivalents, US government money market funds, and asset-backed tokens (Superstate USTB, USDC); monthly independent-accountant (BPM LLP) attestations under the AICPA 2025 Criteria for Stablecoin Reporting (Asset-Backed Fiat Pegged Tokens)

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDH is a Bridge-issued U.S. dollar payment stablecoin for Hyperliquid with 1:1 redemption and monthly reserve attestations.

genius.licensingRegulator: OCC (conditional national trust bank charter granted Feb 12 2026) / FinCEN MSB
genius.notes: Bridge Building Inc. (Stripe subsidiary) received OCC conditional approval on Feb 12 2026 to organize a federally chartered national trust bank (Bridge National Trust Bank), positioning it as a federal-qualified nonbank under the GENIUS Act framework. No PPSI approval exists — the GENIUS Act PPSI framework remains in proposed-rules phase. USDH sunset was announced May 14 2026 (Coinbase acquires brand assets, Hyperliquid transitions to USDC); USDH dashboard closes July 17 2026 but redemption via Bridge (redeem.bridge.xyz) remains available indefinitely. Circulating supply has declined from ~$101M to ~$21M as of June 2026. Reserve attestations continue during sunset period.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official GENIUS Act application exists for Bridge or USDH as of June 7 2026. Bridge received a conditional OCC national trust bank charter (Feb 12 2026) which maps to the federal-qualified-nonbank pathway but is not a PPSI approval. GENIUS rulemaking remains at NPRM stage; no approvals have been granted to any issuer.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDH has HyperEVM and Hyperliquid deployments. Hyperliquid bridge documentation and L2BEAT describe the bridge as validator-signed, with more than two-thirds staking power required for deposits or withdrawals, so Pharos scores this as external validated-network exposure.

notices.title: USDH sunset and redemption migration
notices.message: Bridge and Native Markets announced the USDH migration in May 2026. New issuance is ending except for migration liquidity, the USDH dashboard is supported only during the migration period, and holders should use the fee-free USDH-to-USDC or fiat redemption routes while they remain available.

obituary.epitaph: A Hyperliquid native made way for USDC
obituary.obituary: Native Markets and Bridge announced USDH's sunset in May 2026 as Hyperliquid markets migrated to USDC. New issuance ended except to support migration liquidity; the USDH dashboard was scheduled to close on July 17, while Bridge continued USDH-to-USDC and fiat redemption for onboarded holders. USDH remained fully backed during the transition, but its role as an active stablecoin product ended, so Pharos freezes it as an archived migration asset.
